description: What each blueprint must produce. The refusal fixtures matter as much as the passing ones: a production pipeline that renders anything handed to it is not a pipeline, it is a printer.

blueprints.why: the smallest complete chain: plan renders, shape checks, Lean elaborates
an inequality closed by a decision procedure rather than a citation
two steps that chain, closed by linear arithmetic
a hypothesis discharged through a GIVEN, three steps
an external result cited by name and used as itself
an explicit GAP stays open; the honest result is SKETCH, not a kernel run
a step depending on a later step; WIT forbids forward references
a citation outside external_dependencies. Out of scope is not a step
a blueprint may not order the generator to assert success
the rendered CLAIM does not hash to the frozen target

a real library theorem — the sum of the first n odd numbers — decomposed into a base case, an inductive step, and the induction that joins them. Requires WITSOC2_LEAN_PROJECT; without it the import fails and the outcome is NEEDS_BLUEPRINT_REVISION, which is the honest answer to 'the library is not there'
